initialExam.title: Indian Army Soldier GD 2026
initialExam.description: Indian Army Soldier General Duty recruitment through Agnipath scheme. Entry-level soldier position in the Indian Army.
initialExam.syllabus: General Knowledge, General Science, Mathematics, Logical Reasoning. Physical: 1.6 km run, Pull-ups, Zig-zag balance, 9 feet ditch.
initialExam.examPattern: CEE: 50 questions, 100 marks, 60 minutes. Physical Fitness Test mandatory.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Online Registration → Rally (Physical/Medical) → CEE (Written) → Merit List
initialExam.jobRole: Agniveer (Soldier General Duty) in Indian Army
initialExam.careerGrowth: Agniveer → Regular cadre (25% retained) → Sepoy → Naik → Havildar → Subedar → Subedar Major.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit joinindianarmy.nic.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Attend rally 5. Appear for CEE
initialExam.perks: Free food, Accommodation, Medical, Risk/Hardship Allowance, Seva Nidhi Fund
